title: 结对看测试而不是接管任务
premise: 接口问题明确，Raj请求协助检查游标与取消测试。
listeningTask: 辨别结对协助的范围和任务责任归属。

lines.en: Could someone pair on it before lunch? I need help checking cancellation test design.
lines.zh: 午饭前能有人结对吗？需要帮忙检查取消测试设计。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth for thirty minutes. We'll focus on the test coverage gap.
lines.zh: 我有半小时，聚焦测试覆盖缺口。

lines.en: Just to confirm, Raj keeps implementation ownership, right? Hannah helps validate the failure cases.
lines.zh: 确认一下，实现仍归Raj，对吧？Hannah协助验证失败用例。

lines.en: I'm on it for realistic response samples. Maybe those make cancellation timing less artificial.
lines.zh: 真实响应样本我来准备，能让取消时机不那么人为。

lines.en: Use controlled scheduling in the tests. Real-time sleeps make concurrency tests unreliable.
lines.zh: 测试用可控调度，实际睡眠会让并发测试不稳定。

lines.en: Okay, I'll inject the scheduler for tests. Production behavior doesn't need a new timing policy.
lines.zh: 好，测试注入调度器，生产不必引入新时间策略。

lines.en: Let's take it offline after the standup. We can inspect the test harness together.
lines.zh: 站会后单独聊，一起检查测试框架。

lines.en: Good, today's commitment should remain small enough. Don't turn pairing into a framework rewrite.
lines.zh: 好，今天承诺规模别太大，结对不变成重写框架。

lines.en: I'll review the seam for scheduler injection. Keep it narrow and internal to testing.
lines.zh: 我审查调度器注入点，保持小范围测试用途。

lines.en: I'll join for the first sample walkthrough. Then I'll return to the contract request.
lines.zh: 我参加首个样例讲解，之后回去处理契约请求。
